summary: Iteration 42 tested the requested sports shutdown, dedicated DB-manager authentication and guards, backup lifecycle, admin live-sub cancellation/refund/ticket/action flow, asynchronous AI ticket replies, signed-in AI chat, public chat, transaction-history balance safety, and the new Admin UI tabs against the public URL. Backend focused suite passed 9/11. Core AI, backup, DB user protection, chat, and live-sub flows passed. Sports remains exposed through active APIs, deleting approved transaction history changes the user's actual wallet balance, and the visible /admin login form rejects the documented Balkin credentials even though user-login plus session elevation works.

critical.issue: Deleting an approved transaction changes the user's usable balance. Reproduction: a TEST approved +$0.37 transaction made /api/client/balance $231.89; delete-many removed it and balance fell to $231.52. The users.balance field guard does not protect the real wallet because _get_user_balance derives it from transactions.

Sports is not fully removed: /api/sports/livescores still returns 200 and invokes SofaScore logic; upcoming/leagues and sports betting/admin routes remain registered in server.py. The current feature response is false and the client nav is hidden, but the APIs are active.

minor.issue: Deleting a backup removes only the gzip file, not its db_backups metadata document, leaving orphaned records and unbounded metadata growth. Test-created orphan metadata was cleaned manually.

ui_bugs.issue: The visible /admin form rejects Balkin / Dennis123.@@: it calls legacy /admin/login and then /admin/staff/login, both returning 401. The same credentials succeed through /auth/login followed by /admin/session-from-user, which was used to continue tab testing.

integration_issues.issue: Client Sports navigation is correctly hidden on desktop, mobile bottom navigation, and mobile drawer while sports=false, but SportsView remains imported/renderable and Admin Settings still contains a Sports toggle; backend sports APIs remain live, so the feature can be reintroduced rather than being fully removed.

action_items: Make transaction-history deletion balance-safe. Since the live wallet is transaction-derived, either block destructive deletion of balance-bearing transactions, archive rather than delete, or atomically preserve a canonical wallet ledger/balance before deletion.

Remove all /api/sports/*, /api/client/sports/*, and /api/admin/sports/* routes/workers, remove SportsView/imports and the Admin Sports toggle, and prevent stored feature settings from overriding sports back to true.
Wire the /admin form to dashboard owner authentication plus /admin/session-from-user (or /admin/login-with-account with captcha) so Balkin credentials work without a preloaded user token.
Delete the matching db_backups metadata row when deleting a backup file.
Retest sports route absence, transaction deletion with a real approved ledger item, direct Admin form login, and backup metadata cleanup after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_get_user_balance aggregates approved transaction documents, while dbadmin permits transactions/delete-many. Protecting only users.balance cannot satisfy the requirement that history deletion not wipe balances.

server.py still contains the full sports API/router implementation and external-source logic; ClientDashboard.jsx imports SportsView and conditionally renders it, and Admin.jsx still exposes the sports feature key. DEFAULT_FEATURES sports=false is only concealment, not removal.

Admin.jsx login submits to legacy /admin/login using ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASS defaults, not OWNER_USERNAME/OWNER_PASSWORD; unlike DbManager.jsx, it never performs /auth/login then /admin/session-from-user.
_db_backup_run_once inserts db_backups metadata on each snapshot, but admin_delete_db_backup only unlinks the file and never deletes metadata.

server.py (8,582 lines), Admin.jsx (7,133 lines), and ClientDashboard.jsx remain far beyond the 700-line maintainability threshold; focused linting of Admin.jsx also reports 55 existing errors/warnings. Split these into feature routers/components.

success_rate.frontend: 80% of focused UI groups passed; sports UI hiding, DB-manager login, new Admin tabs/backup, and live-sub cancellation passed; direct Admin login failed

seed_data_creation: Created temporary live subscriptions, approved spend/refund transactions, cancellation tickets/actions, AI support tickets/actions, public/AI chat messages, safe user-note edits, and backup snapshots. All TEST_iter42/TEST_ui42 records, files, and test-created orphan backup metadata were cleaned; the original user note and AI session state were restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run only test_iteration_42_admin_ai_db.py. Current JUnit is 9 pass / 2 fail: sports routes remain active and transaction deletion changes /client/balance. AI ticket auto-reply and AI chat both completed quickly and passed. Browser testing confirmed no Sports UI on desktop/mobile, dedicated dbmanager UI login, all three Admin tabs/tables, Run backup now, and the full Live Subs modal/refund/ticket/action flow. The visible Admin login form still rejects Balkin; preloading tokens through /auth/login + /admin/session-from-user works.
rca_of_the_issue: Balance safety fails because the application has no balance independent of transaction history: _get_user_balance sums approved transactions, while dbadmin delete-many can physically remove those ledger rows. Sports was disabled only through a feature flag; route implementations, external API calls, UI imports, and the admin toggle were retained. Admin credential failure is caused by the form using the separate legacy ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASS route instead of the seeded dashboard owner authentication flow. Backup metadata is orphaned because file deletion lacks a matching db.db_backups.delete operation.
